## Summary

**Defect:** The external browser acceptance suite failed `Editing > should hide other controls when editing` because the `<label>` remained visible while a row was being edited.

**Root cause:** `css/app.css` only hid the checkbox (`.toggle`) and delete button (`.destroy`) during edit mode — it never hid the `.label`, which is what the real-browser visibility check asserted.

**Fix:**
- `css/app.css` — added `.editing label` to the hide-while-editing rule so `.toggle`, `.destroy`, and the `label` are all `display: none` when a row carries the `.editing` class.
- `features/editing-visibility.feature` — added a scenario asserting the label is hidden while editing.
- `features/support/steps.mjs` — added the `the label for {string} is hidden` step (uses `getComputedStyle` over the app stylesheet, consistent with the existing checkbox/destroy checks).

**Verification:** Full harness run — 33 scenarios passed (including the new "label is hidden while editing" scenario); the only non-passing items are the pre-existing undefined shipshape-methodology placeholders, untouched by this change.
